limitations: Certificates, manifests, native library names, and DEX structural identifiers were parsed from 26 local APK files offline without installing, modifying, or executing any APK or native binary.
JDK apksigner full-body digest verification and full JADX Java decompilation were not executed in this environment because JDK/apksigner/jadx are not installed.
DEX analysis inspected class descriptors, package namespaces, AIDL Stub names, structural content:// URIs, .db strings, HTTPS hostnames, and runtime framework markers only.

notable_manifest_processes.interpretation: Non-exported worker services/processes using the application's UID; these are not Android isolated-process sandboxes.

notes: reactivephone.msearch is a third-party Russian search app, not an OPPO/ColorOS system package; its role_group is third_party_or_companion.
HeyTap Browser and Reader are OEM-adjacent products but are treated as non-core companion records in role_group.
Counts are APK file records, not unique package names; multiple versions of Breeno and Pantanal are separate records.

evidence_interpretation.apk_size_bytes: Exact total APK archive length in bytes; ZIP-compressed container size.
evidence_interpretation.notable_native_lib_size_bytes: Exact uncompressed ZIP-entry length in bytes for the listed native .so entry.
evidence_interpretation.human_readable_units: Human-readable MB values in the companion Markdown use decimal megabytes (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes). No MiB is implied unless explicitly labeled.
evidence_interpretation.manifest: Shows declared package metadata, permissions, components, process attributes and intent filters; not runtime invocation evidence.
evidence_interpretation.dex_markers: Class descriptors, namespaces, AIDL names, URI/database strings and hostnames are structural indicators, not proof of runtime call paths or data flows.
evidence_interpretation.native_libraries_and_assets: Names and entry sizes show packaged artifacts, not proof they are loaded, executed, or used by a particular feature.
evidence_interpretation.runtime_claims: Require method-level decompilation/call graphs and/or controlled device traces.
